opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the award duration, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicant may include up to two Co-applicants covering a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering, supported by the Leverhulme Trust, promoting collaboration across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities. Awards up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; prior public engagement experience expected; previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', held 21-23 April 2027, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80% of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of where doctorate obtained; anyone with a UK doctorate eligible; others may qualify via 'strong prior association'. Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. No permanent academic post held.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills in areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination. Awards of 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award. Involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based humanities and social sciences researchers with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines. Awards of 24 months.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the policy sector, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin. Up to two one-year fellowships.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to research expenses, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make applications. Offered on a rolling deadline.
